objects.name: Cyber espionage campaign targeted stock exchange executive’s Outlook account
objects.description: Attackers spent five months silently stealing emails from a stock exchange executive’s Outlook account in a suspected espionage operation. A threat actor quietly sat inside a senior executive’s Outlook account at a major global stock exchange for roughly 150 days, from October 2025 to March 2026.
